about: 30 test students for the Smart Eligibility Checker. Each expected result was worked out by hand from UTAR's official Minimum Entry Requirements (October 2026), not from the program. Run: npm test

fields.programme: Exact programme name, as in database/programmes.sql
fields.input.qualification: spm | olevel | uec | stpm | alevel | foundation | diploma
fields.input.results: [subject, grade] pairs (subject codes as in server/eligibility.js)
fields.expected.reasons: Messages that must appear in the result (conditions or unmet requirements)
fields.expected.foundation: For SPM / O-Level students: the expected result for the Foundation route

cases.student: STPM, good grades, credits in SPM Mathematics and English
cases.rule: STPM C+ (GP 2.33) in 2 subjects; credit in SPM Mathematics; credit in SPM English

cases.student: STPM with two Grade C only
cases.rule: Accounting needs C+ (GP 2.33), so Grade C is not enough

cases.student: STPM, only a pass in SPM Mathematics
cases.rule: Without a credit in SPM Mathematics: admitted but must pass the Mathematics Enhancement Course (MEC)

cases.student: UEC, Grade B5 or better in 5 subjects
cases.rule: UEC Grade B (minimum B5) in 5 subjects; UEC Mathematics and English count as credits

cases.student: STPM, did not pass SPM Mathematics
cases.rule: Without a pass in SPM Mathematics: admitted but must attend and pass MEC

cases.student: STPM, did not pass SPM English
cases.rule: Without a pass in SPM English: admitted but must meet the English requirement through a recognised test

cases.student: A-Level with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
cases.rule: A-Level Grade D in 1 Mathematics subject and 1 Science/ICT subject

cases.student: STPM arts stream, credit in SPM Mathematics and Physics
cases.rule: Arts stream with credit in SPM Mathematics and a Science subject: must take and pass MEC

cases.student: STPM arts stream, no Additional Mathematics or Science credits
cases.rule: Arts stream needs a credit in SPM Additional Mathematics, or SPM Mathematics and a Science subject

cases.student: Foundation CGPA 2.80, only passes in SPM Mathematics and English
cases.programme: Bachelor of Information Systems (Honours) Business Information Systems
cases.rule: Foundation CGPA 2.00; credit in SPM Mathematics (pass: MEC); pass in SPM English only: Intensive English Programme

cases.student: Diploma in Computing, CGPA 2.30
cases.programme: Bachelor of Information Technology (Honours) Communications and Networking
cases.rule: Diploma in Computing CGPA 2.50; below 2.50 but above 2.00: thorough internal evaluation

cases.student: Diploma in Business, CGPA 2.60
cases.programme: Bachelor of Information Technology (Honours) Computer Engineering
cases.rule: Only a Diploma in Computing or in Science and Technology is accepted

cases.student: STPM science stream
cases.programme: Bachelor of Civil Engineering with Honours
cases.rule: STPM Grade C in Mathematics and 1 relevant Natural Science subject

cases.student: STPM arts stream, no Mathematics or Science
cases.programme: Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering with Honours
cases.rule: Engineering needs Mathematics and 1 relevant Natural Science subject

cases.student: SPM leaver with 7 credits including Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
cases.programme: Bachelor of Electrical and Electronic Engineering with Honours
cases.rule: SPM leads to a degree through Foundation in Science: 5 credits including 1 Mathematics and 2 Science subjects

cases.student: SPM leaver with only 3 credits
cases.rule: Foundation in Arts needs 5 SPM credits

cases.student: STPM Biology A, Chemistry A-, Physics B, MUET Band 4
cases.programme: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
cases.rule: STPM BBB / ABC / AAC (or GPA 3.00) in Biology, Chemistry and Physics/Mathematics; MUET Band 4.0; interview if shortlisted

cases.student: STPM Biology B, Chemistry B-, Mathematics B
cases.programme: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
cases.rule: B, B-, B is below BBB (GPA 2.89 < 3.00)

cases.student: UEC B4 or better in Biology, Chemistry, Physics and both Advanced Mathematics papers
cases.programme: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
cases.rule: UEC Grade B4 in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Advanced Mathematics (I) and (II)

cases.student: STPM CGPA 2.70, credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu, MUET Band 3
cases.rule: STPM CGPA 2.0; credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu; MUET Band 3 / IELTS 5.5

cases.student: STPM CGPA 3.10, no credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu
cases.rule: Nursing requires a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu

cases.student: STPM Biology B, Chemistry C+, MUET Band 3
cases.rule: GPA 2.33 in any 2 of Biology, Chemistry, Physics/Mathematics; MUET Band 3

cases.student: STPM with Biology only among the science subjects
cases.rule: Needs 2 of Biology, Chemistry, Physics/Mathematics at GP 2.33

cases.student: STPM science stream, no credit in SPM Art
cases.rule: Applicants without a credit in SPM Pendidikan Seni submit a portfolio

cases.student: STPM with Mathematics, credits in SPM Mathematics and English
cases.programme: Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying with Honours
cases.rule: STPM 3 passes of Grade C including Mathematics; credit in SPM Mathematics and Bahasa Melayu / English

cases.student: UEC with Chinese A1 and English C7
cases.rule: UEC Grade B in 5 subjects; UEC Chinese credit replaces SPM Chinese; a pass in English is enough

cases.student: STPM, credit in SPM English but no MUET Band 4 / IELTS 6
cases.rule: Requires IELTS Band 6.0 / MUET Band 4.0 or equivalent

cases.student: STPM, pass in SPM Mathematics, credit in SPM Science
cases.rule: Without a credit in SPM Mathematics: admitted but must pass MEC

cases.student: STPM applying for a design programme
cases.rule: Every applicant submits a portfolio for review

cases.student: STPM Mathematics B, only a pass in SPM Mathematics
cases.rule: Credit in SPM Mathematics is needed only for applicants without a Principal Pass in STPM Mathematics
